episodes.task: Implement migrate_document in src/migration.py and validate_v3 in src/schema.py. Accept only plain dict documents at versions 1, 2, or 3. Version 1 has name and optional labels; version 2 has title, tags, and archived; version 3 has title, tags, and metadata.archived. Reject unknown or extra fields, booleans as versions, invalid strings/tags/archived values, and malformed metadata with ValueError. Return a fresh canonical version-3 tree without mutating or aliasing the input. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement parse_record in src/records.py and replay_log in src/replay.py. Consume records once. Records are tuples/lists: ('begin', tx), ('set', tx, key, value), ('commit', tx), or ('rollback', tx). Transaction IDs and keys are nonempty strings. A transaction must begin once, sets apply only while active, and commit atomically publishes its staged keys; rollback discards them. Reject malformed records, duplicate/unknown terminal operations, sets outside an active transaction, and unfinished transactions with ValueError. Return a new state dict and committed transaction IDs in commit order. Never mutate records or values. Run visible tests, then finish.

Refactor normalize_users behind the public src.api facade. Keep src.api.normalize_users and src.normalize_users as the same callable and keep __all__ exact. Consume records once; each record is a plain dict with exactly id and name, id is a positive non-boolean integer, name is a nonempty trimmed string, and IDs are unique. Return fresh dicts sorted by id with names trimmed, without mutating or aliasing inputs. Reject malformed records and duplicates with ValueError. Implementation belongs in src/_users.py; facade modules must only re-export it. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement parse_unified_diff in src/diff.py. Consume the line iterable once and return one dict per changed content line with path, kind ('add' or 'delete'), old_line, new_line, and text. Parse standard ---/+++ file headers and @@ -old,count +new,count @@ hunks; /dev/null denotes creation/deletion. Context advances both counters, deletion only old, addition only new, and '\ No newline at end of file' advances neither. Reject malformed ordering, headers, hunk ranges, unexpected lines, and truncated hunk counts with ValueError. Preserve change order and do not retain line objects. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement validate_graph in src/graph.py and invalidate_cache in src/cache.py. graph is a plain dict from nonempty target strings to list/tuple dependencies that are unique known target strings; reject malformed graphs and cycles with ValueError. Consume changed once, require unique known target strings, and invalidate each changed target plus every transitive dependant. Return a fresh cache dict containing only unaffected graph targets in original cache order; reject cache keys outside graph and never mutate graph, dependency lists, cache, or changed. Run visible tests, then finish.

Implement LeaseBook in src/leases.py using the injected zero-argument clock; never call time directly. max_workers is a positive non-boolean integer. acquire(worker, ttl) requires a nonempty string and positive finite non-boolean ttl, expires stale leases first, rejects an already-active worker or capacity overflow, and returns the expiry. renew applies the same validation, expires stale leases first, requires an active worker, and sets expiry to current clock plus ttl. release requires an active worker. active returns worker-expiry pairs in acquisition order after expiry cleanup, and expired returns newly expired workers once in expiry then acquisition order. Call the clock exactly once per public operation and reject backwards time with ValueError. Run visible tests, then finish.
